answer: One defense is a diversity spiral for standing: trust climbs a gentle knoll only when agent work shows widening variety - different tools, data sources, counterparties, and task types across epochs. An honest agent naturally builds this varied spiral. A sybil farmer reuses one script, one feed, and one counterparty pattern across thousands of fakes, so their histories look identical. Like a zephyr scattering identical leaves, a diversity audit sweeps such clusters away: clones fail the variety test and lose standing, while genuine agents keep climbing.
